title: ROCm MI2xx CI/CD workflows failing due to :  download from https://api.github.com/repos/pytorch/pytorch timed out.
bug_description:
## Current Status
ongoing

## Error looks like
```
2025-08-29T10:02:55.5872921Z ##[error]Action 'https://api.github.com/repos/pytorch/pytorch/tarball/5859edf1130cec5a021ace5d5b0e18144808f757' download has timed out. Error: The request was canceled due to the configured HttpClient.Timeout of 100 seconds elapsing. 


[GH job link](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/17320096731/job/49173183969) [HUD commit link](https://hud.pytorch.org/pytorch/pytorch/commit/5859edf1130cec5a021ace5d5b0e18144808f757)
```

## Incident timeline (all times pacific)
8:21PM Aug 28

## User impact
ROCm MI2xx CI and CD signal is red due to this error. MI3xx workflows (eg. `rocm-mi300`, `periodic-rocm-mi300`) seem to not be impacted.

## Root cause
Cirrascale MI250 runners are having a network issue.

## Mitigation
TBD

## Prevention/followups
TBD
